text: Earlier that summer afternoon. <break time="0.8s" /> The two had walked together in the fields. <break time="0.8s" /> And when they sat down on a grassy bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Wing spoke with a sudden, eager passion. <break time="0.8s" /> You are destroying yourself, he cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Because you are too much influenced. <break time="0.8s" /> By the people in this town. <break time="0.8s" /> And you are afraid of your own dreams. <break time="0.8s" /> You must try to forget all you have learned, Wing said. <break time="0.8s" /> And from now on you must shut your ears. <break time="0.8s" /> To the roaring voices around you. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, with his voice growing soft. <break time="0.8s" /> He painted a picture of a golden age. <break time="0.8s" /> In which young men came across the green countryside. <break time="0.8s" /> Some on foot and some on horses. <break time="0.8s" /> They gathered at the feet of an old man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who sat beneath a tree in a tiny garden. <break time="0.8s" /> And they listened eagerly to his words. <break time="0.8s" /> As he talked. <break time="0.8s" /> Wing forgot his hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And slowly they crept forward. <break time="0.8s" /> And came to rest on George Willards shoulders. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a look of horror. <break time="0.8s" /> Swept over his face. <break time="0.8s" /> And jumping to his feet. <break time="0.8s" /> He thrust his hands deep into his pockets. <break time="0.8s" /> While tears came into his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> I must go home now. <break time="0.8s" /> And I cannot talk with you any longer. <break time="0.8s" /> He said nervously. <break time="0.8s" /> And he hurried away across the meadow. <break time="0.8s" /> Without looking back. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaving the young man puzzled and afraid.
